proposals.old_text: Classify the input into exactly one of: urgent, billing, technical, feature, security, other.
proposals.new_text: Classify the input into exactly one of: urgent, billing, technical, feature, security, other. If the input relates to a billing issue, classify it as billing; if it relates to a technical issue, classify it as technical; if it relates to a feature request, classify it as feature; if it relates to a security concern, classify it as security; if it is urgent, classify it as urgent.
proposals.hypothesis: Providing explicit guidance on how to classify inputs based on their context will help the agent make more accurate classifications.
proposals.expected_improvement: This change should reduce misclassifications by clarifying the context for each category.

proposals.new_text: Output ONLY the category name. Ensure that the category reflects the primary concern of the input.
proposals.hypothesis: Emphasizing that the output should reflect the primary concern may help the agent prioritize the most relevant classification.
proposals.expected_improvement: This change should help the agent focus on the main issue presented in the input, leading to fewer misclassifications.

proposals.old_text: Nothing else. No explanation. No reasoning.
proposals.new_text: Nothing else. No explanation. No reasoning. If the input contains multiple issues, prioritize the most urgent or relevant one.
proposals.hypothesis: Instructing the agent to prioritize the most urgent or relevant issue may help it classify inputs that contain multiple concerns more accurately.
proposals.expected_improvement: This change should improve the classification of inputs that may have overlapping categories, particularly urgent cases.
